svg.text: FORCED-AIR MECHANICAL FROTH FLOTATION CELL (TANKCELL ARCHITECTURE)
Stage 1 Beneficiation: Hydrophobic Natural Flake Attachment vs. Depressed Silicate Gangue (ISO 10628 / ANL-22/74 Table 3)
BASIS: 1,000 kg FINISHED cSPG (24,300 kg ROM ORE)
CAD SECTION VIEW A-A | P&ID INSTRUMENTED

g.text: • Depressed Quartz (SiO2), Mica & Feldspar: 21,730 kg (894.2 kg/t ore | 89.42%)
• Unallocated Slimes / Handling Residual: 36 kg (1.5 kg/t ore | 0.15% < 5% Audit Cap)
• Stage 1 Energy: 0.484 kWh/kg conc (1.352 kWh/kg cSPG) + 2.88 MJ/kg Thermal
PHYSICOCHEMICAL INSET: THREE-PHASE CONTACT & CRYSTALLOGRAPHIC SELECTIVITY
A. YOUNG-DUPRE THREE-PHASE CONTACT MECHANICS (HYDROPHOBIC GRAPHITE BASAL PLANE)
NATURAL CRYSTALLINE GRAPHITE FLAKE (sp2 Basal Cleavage Plane {0001} — Non-Polar Hydrophobic)
B. ELECTROSTATIC DEPRESSION OF QUARTZ / MICA GANGUE (SODIUM SILICATE MECHANISM)
Na2SiO3 adsorbs as polymeric silicic acid on quartz/mica,
creating a repulsive negative electrical double layer (zeta = -45 mV).
2. Flotation Collection Probability (P_col = P_c * P_a * (1 - P_d)):
Coarse flakes (+80 mesh, 180 um) require quiescent froth zone
to prevent turbulent detachment (P_d) while multi-stage cleaner
re-grinding liberates locked interlamellar silicate ash to 94-97% C.
• Rejects 894.2 kg gangue per 1,000 kg ROM ore at Stage 1!
C. VERIFIED STAGE 1 MASS, REAGENT & ENERGY LEDGER (ANL-22/74 TABLE 3; USGS 2025)
AUDIT METRICS: Elec: 0.484 kWh/kg conc (1.352 kWh/kg cSPG) | Yield: 10.43% | 94-97% C
PRIMARY PROVENANCE: ANL GREET ANL-22/74 Table 3; Surovtseva (2022); USGS MCS (2025)
